column3: BootUI decides anonymous-data-reach and anonymous-success-on-restricted-route from its authorization layer. FastAPI makes no authorization decision sharpit can observe, and anonymity cannot be proven without running application code, so both kinds report NOT_APPLICABLE with that reason, ahead of any missing-source check. The Security Advisor rule SEC-AUTHZ-001 partly covers a route that forgot its security dependency, on state-changing routes only.
